== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Ranger's Construct]] ([[Sunjiang District]] mission and [[Sunjiang District (explorable area)|explorable area]])

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Equinox]].
* The additional overcast caused by Equinox triggers only after the spell is cast successfully, whereas ordinary overcast occurs when [[activation]] begins.
* The additional overcast stacks with [[Arcane Languor]], resulting in a total 20 additional overcast when using a spell that causes overcast.
